comparison.objective: Release two drawer-slide latches and remove a drawer; candidate tunes and locks an axis shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Simultaneous opposite-sense lever presses while pulling versus key insertion, collar rotation, counterhold and iterative cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Both levers actuated, drawer past stop, removed and released versus two compliant stops and retained collar setting.
comparison.reason: The drawer tests simultaneous latch release under extraction load, not parameter adjustment from dynamic feedback. Candidate rubric has undeclared rebound, overload and drift thresholds.
